svg.text: One chain trial: two sibling chains of 128 back-to-back pairs
No host sync inside either chain. Each chain opens with one all-reduce; the first 16 pairs are dropped as pipeline fill; 4 trials per point.
1. Floors chain: events around each op (4 per pair)
chain_floor_us.dispatch / .combine: each op window, reduced across ranks by MIN. The last rank into a collective waited least,
so its window is the op's floor (within ~10% of profiler kernel time). Chained per-op medians are never published.
2. Period chain: events only around each pair (2 per pair)

g.text: ↑ gap: the host's two record() calls land here

svg.text: pair_period (the headline): each pair window, reduced across ranks by MEDIAN. The collectives lock all ranks to one cadence,
so the period is a rate and a MAX would only report the rank that hiccuped.
interpair_gap_us = start-to-start − pair window; pair_spread_us = per-pair cross-rank spread; settle_drift_us = late − early half.
